categories.main_business_segments: Jiujiang Defu Technology primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-performance electrolytic copper foil. Its products are categorized into lithium battery copper foil and electronic circuit copper foil, serving applications in lithium-ion batteries, copper-clad laminates, and printed circuit boards. The company also operates subsidiaries involved in related materials, chemical additives, and equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced electrochemical and materials science technologies for copper foil production, including proprietary additive formulations and process optimizations. It has developed ultra-thin, high-strength, and multi-structured copper foils such as porous, atomized, and core foils tailored for next-generation batteries. Production lines are self-designed and optimized with AI-driven energy management and quality control systems, adhering to automotive and international quality standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers like CATL, BYD, Guoxuan High-Tech, and ATL, as well as electronic materials companies such as Shengyi Technology and Lianmao Electronics. The end markets served are new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, 3C digital products, AI servers, high-frequency communication devices, and semiconductor packaging. The company also targets overseas strategic clients in Taiwan, Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Jiangxi (Jiujiang) and Gansu (Lanzhou). It serves domestic markets across North China, East China, South China, Central China, and Southwest China, with growing overseas business in East Asia and Southeast Asia. The company also has subsidiaries and investment entities in Hong Kong for international trade and investment.
categories.supply_chain_position: Defu Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the copper foil supply chain, producing high-value copper foil materials used as key components in lithium-ion batteries and electronic circuit boards. It extends upstream into chemical additive production and raw material supply through subsidiaries and strategic partnerships, and downstream through direct sales and collaboration with battery and electronics manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment focusing on ultra-thin, high-strength copper foils, multi-structured foils for solid-state and lithium-metal batteries, and high-frequency electronic copper foils. It aims to lead in domestic high-end product localization and technology breakthroughs, integrating AI and digitalization into manufacturing. Strategic projects include developing next-generation battery materials, expanding production capacity, and enhancing energy efficiency and carbon reduction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electrolytic copper foil products, including lithium battery copper foil and electronic circuit copper foil. The company follows a cost-plus pricing model based on copper market prices plus processing fees. Additional income sources include government subsidies, technology service fees, and sales of scrap materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Defu Technology is positioned among the top tier of domestic copper foil manufacturers in China, competing with companies like Shengyi Technology, Guoxuan High-Tech, and BYD. It holds a leading market share in the domestic electrolytic copper foil industry, particularly in high-performance lithium battery copper foil segments, and is recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and strategic partnerships with industry leaders.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 7.8 billion, a 19.5% increase from 2023, with electrolytic copper foil sales volume growing 17.2%. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 245 million due to increased costs and industry price pressures. Total assets reached RMB 14.9 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and R&D. The company maintains a growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and market penetration despite short-term profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Defu Technology differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies enabling ultra-thin, high-strength, and multi-functional copper foils that enhance battery energy density, safety, and cycle life. Its vertically integrated supply chain, strong R&D team, and strategic collaborations with leading battery and electronics manufacturers provide stable, high-quality supply and customized solutions. The company also emphasizes sustainable manufacturing practices, energy efficiency, and carbon footprint reduction as part of its competitive edge.
